name: Totality of circumstances

subjectOf.text: Given the defects of a party location analysis, courts should de-emphasize where the parties are and instead use a totality of the circumstances approach to determine where a privately negotiated derivative transaction took place.
subjectOf.abstract: perhaps de-emphasizing the location of the parties while focusing on the totality of the circumstances could help establish appropriate parameters to determine where a privately negotiated derivative transaction took place.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal and Painter, The Aftermath of Morrison v. National Australia Bank and Elliott Associates v. Porsche (2011). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1765901
scope_conditions: privately negotiated derivative transactions under Morrison

subjectOf.text: The Second Circuit should uphold Judge Baer's ruling on a totality of the circumstances basis and explain more fully how those circumstances determine the location of a swap agreement under Morrison.
subjectOf.abstract: The Second Circuit should uphold Judge Baer's ruling based on the totality of the circumstances and also explain more completely how these circumstances should be evaluated for the purpose of determining the location of a swap agreement under Morrison.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal and Painter, The Aftermath of Morrison v. National Australia Bank and Elliott Associates v. Porsche (2011). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1765901
